## Purpose

Explain the problem and why the change is useful.

## Change and scope

Describe the resulting behavior. State whether this changes computation,
configuration, interpretation, documentation or packaging.

## Evidence

List the checks actually run, their outcomes and relevant records. For a
computational correction, include the regression case that demonstrates it.
For a documentation-only change, identify the relevant link/command/figure checks.

## Experiment identity

If the change affects actions, targets, support, calibration, selection or
reporting, describe its effect on existing results and the new run identity.
Keep earlier result-producing artifacts with their original source.
